reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for flagging this. Before resending anything, I checked the transfer with Access Bank directly, and their final status for TRF-INV-88 shows the money WAS credited:

- Transfer: TRF-INV-88
- Amount: ₦250,000
- Account: 0234567891, Access Bank
- Bank status: Credited to the recipient account
- Credited at: 21 November 2026, 14:02 (UTC)
- Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088

Although our own dashboard marks the transfer as "failed", your bank has confirmed the funds landed in your account. Because of that, I don't want to resend ₦250,000 — you'd risk being paid twice, and we'd have to ask for the duplicate back.

Could you please check your Access Bank statement/balance around 21 November (just after 2pm), or ask your bank to trace the credit using the session ID above? If Access Bank confirms they have no record of the credit despite the session ID, let me know and I'll escalate it right away so we can sort it out.

Apologies for the confusion on our side's status display — happy to help however we can.
